# AnythingMCP

> Turn any REST/OpenAPI, SOAP/WSDL, GraphQL, OData or SQL API into MCP tools for Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot, no code. 563 pre-built adapters for ERP, e-commerce and more (SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business One, Odoo, Xentral, JTL-Wawi, Shopware, WooCommerce, Amazon Seller). Self-hosted, open source (AGPL-3.0).

## Getting started

- [AnythingMCP: self-hosted MCP gateway](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/README.md): Run AnythingMCP locally, connect an AI client, and discover ready-made connectors.
- [Deployment Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/deployment.md): Deploy AnythingMCP with Docker and configure authentication, networking, and production settings.
- [AnythingMCP — Client setup, connector types & FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/guides.md): Guides for connecting AI clients to AnythingMCP, the connector types you can build, and frequently asked questions.

## Connectors

- [SQL database to MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/connectors/database.md): AnythingMCP lets Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot query PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, SAP HANA, SQLite and MongoDB through MCP,...
- [GraphQL to MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/connectors/graphql.md): AnythingMCP turns any GraphQL API into MCP tools for Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot without code.
- [LOGIN_TOKEN Authentication](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/connectors/login-token-auth.md): Build connectors that exchange credentials for cached bearer tokens with automatic refresh and re-login.
- [MCP Bridge Connector — MCP-to-MCP Gateway](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/connectors/mcp-bridge.md): The MCP Bridge connector lets you connect to other MCP servers and re-expose their tools through AnythingMCP.
- [OData to MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/connectors/odata.md): AnythingMCP connects Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot to OData V2 and V4 services through MCP, with SAP Gateway (S/4HANA, ECC, BW) as a first-class case.
- [Per-user sign-in for OAuth2 connectors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/connectors/per-user-sign-in.md): By default an OAuth2 connector is authorized once: whoever clicks "Authorize with Provider" signs in, and every user of the workspace then calls the...
- [Proxy / Web-Unblocker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/connectors/proxy.md): Some upstream APIs block server-side requests — by IP reputation, geo, rate limits, or full anti-bot systems (Akamai Bot Manager, Cloudflare, DataDome).
- [REST / OpenAPI to MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/connectors/rest.md): AnythingMCP turns any REST API into MCP tools for Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot without code.
- [SAP HANA to MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/connectors/sap-hana.md): AnythingMCP connects Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot to SAP HANA through MCP: any HANA database as a Database connector, and SAP S/4HANA's HANA database through...
- [SOAP / WSDL to MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/connectors/soap.md): AnythingMCP turns a SOAP web service into MCP tools for Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot without code.
- [Tool Definition Format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/tool-definition.md): Define MCP tool parameters, endpoint mappings, response transforms, and adapter metadata.

## AI clients

- [Connect AnythingMCP to ChatGPT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/integrations/chatgpt.md): ChatGPT on the web can add a custom remote MCP server as a plugin, so you can use your AnythingMCP tools directly in ChatGPT conversations.
- [Connect AnythingMCP to Claude](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/integrations/claude.md): Every MCP server you create in AnythingMCP has its own endpoint.
- [Connect AnythingMCP to GitHub Copilot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/integrations/copilot.md): GitHub Copilot supports MCP server connections in VS Code and JetBrains IDEs (agent mode).
- [Connect AnythingMCP to Google Gemini](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/integrations/gemini.md): Google Gemini supports MCP server connections through Gemini CLI and the Gemini API.
- [Connect AnythingMCP to Meta Muse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/integrations/muse.md): Meta Muse can use remote MCP servers as custom connectors.

## Operations and security

- [Operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/operations/README.md): Documents that exist for the people running AnythingMCP in production rather than the people building it.
- [Backup & restore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/operations/backup-restore.md): AnythingMCP stores all state in PostgreSQL.
- [Disaster recovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/operations/disaster-recovery.md): Targets we hold ourselves to for AnythingMCP-the-managed-product.
- [Observability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/operations/observability.md): Configure structured logging, Sentry error reporting, and Prometheus metrics for your deployment.
- [Row-Level Security (defense-in-depth tenant isolation)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/operations/row-level-security.md): AnythingMCP isolates tenants at the application layer today: every org-scoped query carries an explicit where: { organizationId }, and the MCP endpoints are...
- [Service level objectives](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/operations/slo.md): These are the SLOs we commit to for the managed AnythingMCP cloud.
- [Single Sign-On (Microsoft Entra ID, Google, Okta, Auth0, OIDC)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/sso.md): Let members sign in with your organization's identity provider instead of a password, and keep their AnythingMCP roles in step with your directory groups.
- [SCIM provisioning with Microsoft Entra ID — step by step](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/scim-entra-setup.md): Click-by-click setup for automatic user and group provisioning from Entra ID into AnythingMCP.
- [License FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/license-faq.md): Understand the AGPL license, the commercial EE boundary, and contributor licensing.

- [Workspace memory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp/main/docs/memory.md): Workspace memory lets AI clients save facts, preferences and notes and find them again later, in any client connected to an MCP server of the workspace...
